logout.label: Log out
logout.title: Log out?
logout.description: You will need to sign in again to access your workspace.

resourceList.emptyDefaultDescription: Items will appear here once you add them.
resourceList.noMatchDescription: Try a different search term or clear the filter.

agentsList.title: Assistants
agentsList.description: Chat assistants configured for this workspace. Each assistant can have its own skills, tools, and knowledge.
agentsList.emptyDescription: Create an assistant to start chatting, embedding on a site, or connecting to support channels.

connectionsList.title: Chat channels
connectionsList.description: Channels linked to your assistants, such as Facebook Messenger, website widgets, and messaging apps.
connectionsList.emptyDescription: Connect Facebook pages or other channels to route conversations to assistants.

slug.label: Slug
slug.description: Unique identifier referenced in agent prompts (e.g. guest_support).
slug.changeWarning: Changing the slug may break agent prompts that reference the old slug.
slug.taken: This slug is already used in the workspace.

name.label: Name
name.description: Display name shown in lists and agent skill pickers.

useCases.label: When to use
useCases.description: Describe the situations where the assistant should apply this skill.
useCases.placeholder: Guest asks about check-in, house rules, or booking changes.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.description: Guidance injected into the agent system prompt when this skill is attached.
instructions.placeholder: When handling guest support, prioritize booking details, house rules, and check-in instructions...

general.helperTitle: This is your assistant's identity card
general.helperDescription: Set the name, short description, the AI model that powers it, and the greeting it opens with. These are the basics everyone on your team sees.
general.sectionDescription: The name and short description your team sees.
general.name: Name
general.modelDialogDescription: Select the AI model that powers this assistant.
general.firstMessageDescription: The greeting the assistant opens a conversation with.
general.firstMessagePlaceholder: Hello! How can I help you today?
general.clearContextDescription: Remove all chat sessions and the assistant cache. This does not delete the assistant. Use it when you want to start fresh.
general.clearContextConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete all chat sessions and cached conversation memory for {{name}}. The assistant itself will not be deleted.
general.dangerDescription: Permanently remove this assistant and its configuration. This action cannot be undone.
general.deleteConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete {{name}}. This action cannot be undone.

instructions.helperTitle: Teach your assistant how to behave
instructions.helperDescription: Instructions describe who the assistant is and how it should reply.
instructions.promptDescription: Tell the assistant who it is and how it should behave.
instructions.mentionHint: Tip: type @ to mention a tool or skill. Markdown works too — headings, lists, and **bold**.

skills.helperDescription: Skills are optional abilities for specific situations. Each skill defines when to use it and what the assistant should do.
skills.emptyDescription: Add a skill to give this assistant use cases and extra instructions.
skills.removeConfirmDescription: This will remove {{name}} from this assistant and delete it if no other assistants use it.
skills.slugTaken: This slug is already used in the workspace.

tools.helperTitle: Connect your assistant to outside apps
tools.helperDescription: Tools let the assistant take real actions in other services — for example send an email, look up an order, or create a ticket. Add only what this assistant needs.
tools.sectionDescription: Add integrations from the available catalog and configure each one for this assistant.
tools.emptyDescription: Choose one from the available catalog to get started.
tools.addDialogDescription: Choose a tool from the available catalog. You can configure it after adding.
tools.noneAvailable: No tools are available in the catalog.
tools.removeConfirmDescription: This will remove {{name}} from this assistant and delete its configuration.
tools.slugTaken: This slug is already used in the workspace.

knowledge.helperDescription: Documents are the reference material the assistant reads to answer questions accurately, such as product guides, policies, or FAQs.
knowledge.emptyDescription: Create a knowledge base to upload documents this assistant can reference.
knowledge.deleteConfirmDocuments: All {{count}} documents in this knowledge base will be removed, including uploaded files and search indexes.
knowledge.deleteConfirmAgents: Agents linked to this knowledge base will lose access. This action cannot be undone.
knowledge.noDocumentsDescription: Upload PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, EPUB, RTF, or Markdown files up to 50 MB.
knowledge.addDialogDescription: Name a collection for related documents. You can upload files after creating it.
knowledge.name: Name
knowledge.descriptionPlaceholder: Answers to frequently asked guest questions.
knowledge.createdAndAdded: Knowledge base created and added to the assistant.

capabilities.dialogDescription: Select the {{noun}} this assistant can use.

tool.title: Assistant tools
tool.description: External integrations available to this assistant.
